title: backlog.py new refuses a touch git history has and the working tree lacks, as check does
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the review story's done refused once because a parked story filed in the review named _tools/test_bl_land.py, a path an earlier change removed; backlog.py new filed it and only check (run by done) refused it. new refuses, or set warns of, a touch that git history has and the working tree lacks, naming the same remedy check names, so a gone path is caught at filing.
